capabilities: create structured meeting notes from Markdown templates via a form
append date-and-outcome entries to meeting journals
review, filter, and update tasks in a searchable dashboard
organize notes and journals by year/month, year-only, or flat folder structures
add standalone tasks with title, assignee, and due date
extras: Works fully offline with no account, telemetry, or network requests. README notes the plugin is not yet in the official community directory and gives manual-install steps; interface is bilingual (English/Russian).
motivation: The author built it to reduce the effort required to write a useful MoM, replacing those manual steps with one compact form.
problem: Creating a consistent meeting note in Obsidian means manually creating a file, picking a folder, copying headings, formatting checkbox tasks, and naming the note by hand.
summary: Meeting-notes plugin that creates minutes of meeting from template-driven forms, appends quick journal entries, and manages tasks in a searchable dashboard.
